name: WRECK CIRCUIT: Behemoth Demolition Open
description: Predating the more polished WRECK PROTOCOL tournament by several years, the WRECK CIRCUIT is an independent machine combat series running in repurposed Great Lakes industrial yards, pitting decommissioned and custom-built autonomous machines against each other in elimination demolition formats. Machines are not alive — they are steel, hydraulics, and combat logic — and the WRECK CIRCUIT treats them accordingly, with no restrictions on weapon loadouts or arena hazards. Crowds of thousands gather in condemned infrastructure to watch multi-ton machines dismantle each other with industrial efficiency.
story_hooks: A machine builder discovers her most successful demolition unit contains salvaged components from a corporate military prototype — and someone wants those components back.
A Tier 3 journalist embeds with the WRECK CIRCUIT for a profile piece and begins to suspect the gray-market operation is a front for moving restricted augmentation hardware.
A legendary WRECK CIRCUIT machine, undefeated for eleven years, is scheduled for decommissioning by its builder's estate — and the Shelf community's grief is unexpectedly fierce.
